description: A jQuery plugin for image cropping, including functions for selection, dragging, resizing, shading, and event handling.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets a new image source and updates the cropping interface accordingly.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the cropping selection to specified coordinates.

methods.name: setSelect
methods.description: Sets the cropping selection to specified rectangle.

methods.name: tellSelect
methods.description: Returns the current selection coordinates in original image scale.

methods.name: tellScaled
methods.description: Returns the current selection coordinates scaled to the display size.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets a CSS class for the cropping holder element.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the cropping interface and restores original image.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Activates key support for cropping controls.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the image in original scale.

methods.name: getWidgetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cropping widget.

methods.name: getScaleFactor
methods.description: Returns the scale factors between original and displayed image.
